description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot configuration class WebCorsConfig that sets up global Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) policies for the application. It specifies allowed origins, HTTP methods, headers, and other CORS settings to enable cross-origin requests to the application's endpoints under /bank-api, facilitating integration with tools like Swagger UI and browser-based UIs.

classes.name: WebCorsConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class implementing WebMvcConfigurer to define custom CORS mappings allowing cross-origin requests from specified origins, with configured HTTP methods, headers, and credentials.

methods.name: WebCorsConfig
methods.description: Constructor that initializes allowed origins from environment variable ALLOWED_ORIGINS or a default set of origins.

methods.name: addCorsMappings
methods.description: Overrides the method to specify CORS policies, including allowed origins, methods, headers, exposed headers, and other settings.
